status: Frozen before real-read scientific outcomes; source-admission pilot only is allowed beforehand.
objective: B: same actual read, nested observed150/300nt context. C: independent-acquisition concordance with HG005 GIAB v4.2.1 at predefined variant targets; not genome-wide discovery accuracy or molecular ground truth.
source_acquisition: 2024-09-11, flowcell PAW87816, sample HG005; earlier GIAB v4.2.1 benchmark. Do not use HP tags as independent truth.
candidate_ascertainment: HG002 frozen2024 chr22 PASS biallelic simple indels2-30nt, minimum allele length1. Candidate discovery independent of HG005 reads. HG005 positives require exact VCF allele match, homozygous alternate1/1 or1|1, no other HG005 variant within500bp flanks. Negatives require the whole reference context inside HG005 confident BED and no HG005 VCF record overlapping that context. Reject complex or representation-conflicted regions rather than count a mismatch as error. All candidate REF bases must match exact CRAM reference.
selection: Separately rank positive and negative candidates by SHA256 MP35_HG005|chr22|position|ref|alt. First32 of each class calibration; next32 each test. Require64 per class; otherwise report INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_LOCI without relaxing. 64calibration and64test loci. No reused locus between splits.
reads: Primary mapped, MAPQ>=20, nonduplicate, nonQCfail; exact alignment mapping of the VCF anchor to a query base; require150 query bases on both sides of anchor; ACGT only. Sort eligible reads by SHA256 query_name and retain first20/site, minimum10; fewer means site not evaluable, do not replace. Preserve exclusions, reference coordinates, orientation and read IDs. Sequence stored in reference-facing orientation as supplied by pysam; no extra reverse complement. Query views [anchor-75,anchor+75) and[anchor-150,anchor+150), nested from one record; no inferred bases.
scores: Canonical REF/ALT templates with500bp flanks, no label-derived local haplotypes; minimum unit edit distance over positive template substrings, cap600. Expected allele from homozygous benchmark is a conditional comparison label, not direct molecule truth.
calibration: For each length, whole-site maximum expected-label absolute score and expected-minus-best score over retained reads. Paired rule at nominal95% with alpha/2 to each component, rank ceil((n+1)*0.975). Require>=40 evaluable calibration loci; otherwise stop. Freeze thresholds before evaluating test reads. Neither genotype nor test data chooses thresholds.
B_endpoints: All retained test-read paired transitions correct/discordant singleton, ambiguous, empty relative to expected homozygous label. Site-block empirical coverage reported separately. Primary descriptive success: more concordant singletons at300, no more discordant singletons, site coverage>=95%; no automatic inference of molecular accuracy.
C_endpoints: Per test site and length, singleton consensus only if>=80% of retained reads give the same singleton; all other sites abstain. Report positive/negative confusion matrix including abstentions, sensitivity denominator all planned positive test sites, specificity denominator all planned negative test sites. Non-evaluable is unresolved, never silently dropped. No universal PPV because balanced enriched candidate panel. No claim of de novo variant discovery recall.
limits: HG005 is a reference cell line, not an editing experiment; absence from VCF is admitted only within benchmark BED under simple isolated context rules. Chronological independence of acquisition does not prove independence of every computational preprocessing choice. Conditional locus coverage assumes exchangeability, not established by this sample.
runtime: CPU Colab viaCLI; source-bound atomic checkpoints per site, archive after each batch, total cap24h; range access only, never download full CRAM locally. Batches of8 loci. Report all exclusions and failures. Stop source-stage if decoding or reference identity fails. Manuscripts remain private.
